overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could discuss the Police Chief in open session, so neither individual notice nor executive session was required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to give the Police Chief individual notice that he would be discussed at the November 5 open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board discussed the Police Chief in open session, it was not required to personally notify the Police Chief that it would be discussing him.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board should have met in executive session because it discussed the Police Chief's reputation and character at the November 5 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Even if the Board discussed the reputation and character of the Police Chief during the meeting, it was not required to do so in executive session and the subject of the discussion has no right under the Open Meeting Law to demand that the Board do so.
